description: What buyers actually paid on eBay for a card: blended sold comps, or for language DE, ES and IT one pool of that language's sales on every eBay site (valuation_type pooled_comps). Filter by seller-stated condition and by finish (reverse holo, 1st edition) to compare like with like. For one eBay site use flipzi_get_marketplace_comps; for the individual sales, flipzi_get_sales. Requires the pro plan or higher. Cost: 1 unit.

card_id.description: Flipzi card id (UUID). Get it from flipzi_search_cards or flipzi_list_set_cards.

condition.description: Only ungraded copies whose eBay titles state this condition (near mint, lightly/moderately/heavily played, damaged; seller-stated, not verified). Implies grade RAW. Omit for the price across conditions (which leaves out hp and dmg). Pro and above.

finish.description: Which finish to read. Default standard; a finish the card does not have returns an empty result.

grade.description: Grade code, e.g. RAW, PSA_10, BGS_9.5. Graded values need the Pro plan.

language.description: Listing language: EN, JA, DE, FR, IT, ES, ZH. Default: the card's own language.

name: flipzi_get_sold_comps
title: Sold comparisons
